chunks: And through his chain of narration, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), that he said:
My best brother is Ali, and my best paternal uncles are Hamza and Abbas, the cousin of my father.
ai.seo_question: Who are considered the best brothers and uncles of the Prophet Muhammad according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) designates Ali as his 'best brother' (akh), a title often interpreted in Shia scholarship as signifying spiritual kinship and succession rather than biological lineage, given Ali's cousin status. He further honors Hamza and Abbas as his 'best paternal uncles' (a'mam), distinguishing them within the Banu Hashim for their bravery and steadfastness, thereby establishing the preeminence of the Ahl al-Bayt within the broader tribal structure.
